name: Italian-Style Turkey Burger with Mozzarella & Tomato Caesar Salad

instructions.primary_message: Place turkey, eggs, bread crumbs, and spices in a large bowl; mix with your hands until well combined. Form the turkey mixture into 6 equal-sized patties and place on a plate.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg ground turkey
3 eggs
¾ cup panko bread crumbs
1 ½ tsp Italian seasoning
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add burger patties and cook, undisturbed, for 5 minutes.
When the patties are done on one side, flip, then top with cheese. Continue to cook until burgers are cooked through, 5-7 minutes more. Transfer to a clean plate.
While the burgers are cooking, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lemons
1 ½ small pkgs grape tomatoes
1 ½ heads romaine lettuce

instructions.primary_message: Juice lemons into a clean large bowl.
Peel and mince garlic; mince anchovy fillets. Add both to the bowl with the lemon juice, along with mayo, salt, and pepper, then whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
3 anchovy fillets, packed in oil
3 tbsp mayonnaise
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Halve grape tomatoes. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Remove 3 whole lettuce leaves, cut in half, and set aside for the burgers. Chop (or tear) remaining lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl, toss to combine the salad, and set aside.
Spread mayo over the bottom half of each bun; top with burger patties and reserved lettuce. Close with the top half of each bun. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!
